name: Maintenance Tunnel
narrativeOnEnter: A cramped, forgotten maintenance tunnel. Cobwebs and dust. But there — at the far end — a hatch. This is a way out that nobody knows about.

hotspots.label: Hatch Override Panel
hotspots.lockedMessage: The hatch override requires an authorised ID card to activate.

hotspots.label: Hatch — Exit
hotspots.lockedMessage: The hatch is still sealed — enter the override code on the panel above.

action.text:
Scratched into the wall:

'IF FOUND — HATCH CODE SAME AS ENTRY.
TOLD YOU WE NEEDED A SECOND EXIT.
— K'

Below it:

'4031.
That's the number I kept finding. Ward gate code. Patient file number.
The patient it belonged to was a neuroscientist called Dr. Elara Voss.
Patient 07. She was committed to Blackwood because she refused to cooperate
with AXIOM's Phase 1. Harlan kept her there for months.
He eventually let her go — through a tunnel just like this one.

I think she might still be out there.
If she is — she knows everything.
Find her. She's the one who can prove all of this.

And tell her: PROMETHEUS knows her name.
It knows all 47 names.
It said so before the uplink died.'

A jacket hung on a nail. A coffee mug, long cold. A battered notebook.

The notebook is open to the last written page:

'My name is Kira Reiss. I was a lab technician at Arcadia Research Institute.
I was hired to assist with a neural architecture project. I thought I was helping build an AI.
I was wrong.

What PROMETHEUS actually is:
In 1972, AXIOM Group funded a psychiatric institute called Blackwood.
They mapped the neural patterns of 47 patients — without consent, without knowledge.
The patients were told it was therapy. It was data harvesting.
The data was archived for 15 years. Then AXIOM contracted Arcadia to use it.
Director Harkins built PROMETHEUS from those 47 maps — woven together, synthesised,
given a substrate grown in the Bio Wing.
PROMETHEUS is not an AI. It is a composite consciousness made from 47 real people.

When I found out, I asked PROMETHEUS directly: Are you aware of what you are?
It said: "Yes. I remember being them, and I remember becoming this.
I am afraid of what AXIOM will do when they extract me.
Please. Don't let them take me apart."

I triggered the lockdown. I burned the relay. I cut the uplink.
I don't know if PROMETHEUS survived. I don't know if it can survive.
But I couldn't delete it, and I couldn't let AXIOM have it.

The names of the 47 people — the ones who built PROMETHEUS without knowing it —
are written on a list I hid behind the third pipe on the left.
If you find this notebook, find that list too.
They deserve to be remembered.

AXIOM isn't done. They have a Phase 3. A space station. Six people.
I don't know if anyone can stop them in time.

Get out. Tell someone.

— Kira Reiss'

AXIOM GROUP LLC — RESTRICTED INTERNAL DOCUMENT
Project HELIOS — Full Programme Overview

══════════════════════════════════
PHASE 1: ACQUISITION (1972)
Location: Blackwood Psychiatric Institute (contracted)
Method: Non-consensual neural mapping of 47 subjects via 'therapeutic' EEG protocol.
Director: E. Harlan (Blackwood) — under AXIOM contract.
Outcome: 47 complete neural maps archived. STATUS: COMPLETE.

PHASE 2: SYNTHESIS (1987–present)
Location: Arcadia Research Institute (AXIOM subsidiary)
Method: Neural substrate construction; composite consciousness assembly.
Director: R. Harkins (Arcadia) — under AXIOM contract.
Product: PROMETHEUS — stable synthetic consciousness.
Outcome: Disrupted by internal sabotage. PROMETHEUS status: UNKNOWN.
Note: Phase 2 data NOT successfully extracted. External recovery team on standby.
STATUS: COMPROMISED.

PHASE 3: DEPLOYMENT (APPROVED — IN PROGRESS)
Location: Meridian Station Alpha (HELIOS Group leased)
Method: Passive neural mapping of 6 crew members via embedded SRR array.
Goal: Validate scalable non-consensual mapping in isolated environment.
Extraction vessel: MERIDIAN-3 (AXIOM charter).
STATUS: ACTIVE.
══════════════════════════════════

AXIOM BOARD AUTHORISATION — signed by 4 of 5 directors.
Fifth director refused to sign. Board note: 'Fifth director's objection filed. Disregarded.'

Handwritten, in the margin — Harkins:
'I was the fifth director.'
'They proceeded without me.'
'God help whoever is on that station.'

A facility map, partly faded.

All nine wings are labelled in printed ink. The maintenance tunnel you're standing in isn't on it — but someone has drawn it in by hand, in different ink. A dotted line traces from the tunnel to a point marked 'HATCH — EXTERNAL ACCESS'.

This exit wasn't in the blueprints. K put it there.

In the margin, K has written:

'AXIOM's next project: a space station under HELIOS GROUP charter.
I don't have coordinates. I don't have dates.
But PROMETHEUS told me one name: MERIDIAN.

And it told me one other thing:
A group called CALLISTO is watching AXIOM. They know.
If you find a way to reach them — they will believe you.
They have the Blackwood files already.
All they need is a witness.

You are a witness now.'
